passages.note: Assembly floor vote of 06/27/22 on SCA 10, with Ward in the Ayes and 17 Noes of 80 voting, so not near-unanimous.

passages.provision_quote: The state shall not deny or interfere with an individual’s reproductive freedom in their most intimate decisions, which includes their fundamental right to choose to have an abortion and their fundamental right to choose or refuse contraceptives.
passages.note: The operative added section declares a right and states no gestational limit and no exception rule.

rows.reasoning: Ward voted Aye on SCA 10 (2021-2022), whose operative added section says "The state shall not deny or interfere with an individual’s reproductive freedom in their most intimate decisions, which includes their fundamental right to choose to have an abortion". That declares a right and names no limit, so it does not say abortion is legal "at every stage of pregnancy, with no time limit" (V4.2 "Silence is not a clause"); it also fixes no point for "through the second trimester" or "during the first trimester". The vote places him on the permissive side without choosing among those rungs.
